_comment: External M3U lists merged into channels.json on each scheduled run. 'categories' filters by the source's group-title (iptv-org category names); each matching category maps to the Arabic group shown in the player. 'playlist': 'adult' routes channels to playlist_adult.m3u instead of playlist.m3u. iptv-org stopped publishing adult channels in January 2024, so there is no adult source here.
